verdict.rationale: AgentMail has a dashboard/Console, so keyboard-driven operation is a fair question to ask of it, but the evidence pack never mentions keyboard shortcuts, a command palette, or how responsive the app interface is. The CLI is a different capability and does not count as keyboard shortcuts in the interface.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can do everything from the keyboard — comprehensive shortcuts and a command palette — in an interface fast enough to never make me wait
